remarks: Experience the best of Ellicottville in every season from this charming Craftsman-style mountain retreat. Ideally located just 0.75 miles from the village and approximately 2 miles from the slopes, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers sweeping slope views, stunning sunsets, and the natural beauty that makes Ellicottville such a special place to call home or escape to. The spacious eat-in kitchen features generous counter space, a breakfast nook, built-in desk, and first-floor laundry. A formal dining room is ready for holiday gatherings and après-ski dinners, while the cozy living room and additional sitting area with rustic barn doors and a classic brick fireplace offer plenty of space to gather and unwind. Two first-floor bedrooms and a full bath provide convenience, while upstairs you'll find two additional bedrooms, a full bath with a jacuzzi tub, and a half bath. The primary bedroom captures beautiful sunset views, creating a peaceful retreat after a day of adventures. Outside, the flagstone and stone patio sets the scene for out of this world evenings, fireside gatherings, and stargazing under the wide-open, near dark sky. Surrounded by open space with no immediate neighbors, this property offers a rare sense of privacy. Enjoy everything Ellicottville has to offer, from trouncing through the village to mountain biking, golf, and winter days on the slopes. Whether you're looking for a full-time home with a little more breathing room or a mountain getaway to enjoy on weekends and holidays, this property offers the flexibility to make it your own. Offered mostly furnished, it's ready for you to settle in, slow down, and enjoy the Ellicottville lifestyle year-round.
